refresh_policy.default_change_policy: no website change unless the existing page would make a material user judgment wrong

refresh_policy.rule_refresh_boundary: Rules use only the verified current E release; dirty or unreleased source never overwrites it and does not block unrelated project refreshes

The fixed 35-project value plan renders 23 published projects after adding DevConfig Backup, bringing the compact search projection to 308 records. The current shared/all-project search measures 120748/139481 gzip bytes, so the two lines use the minimum passing integers 118/144 KiB. Required narratives remain in route-specific static HTML rather than shared JavaScript; the sunshine-remote-streaming shard and existing maximum PCConfig shard remain within 21 KiB.
